    def add_path(tree, tree_nodes, path):
        for i in range(len(path) - 1):
            s, t = path[i], path[i + 1]
            if not tree.has_edge(s, t):
                tree.add_edge(s, t, data=G[s][t])
            tree_nodes.update([s, t])

    # ---- Candidate 1: greedy cheapest-attachment Steiner heuristic ----
    def build_greedy():
        tree_nodes, tree, remaining = {src}, nx.DiGraph(), set(dsts)
        while remaining:
            best = None
            for dst in remaining:
                for node in tree_nodes:
                    dist, paths = sp_from(node)
                    if dst in dist and (best is None or dist[dst] < best[0]):
                        best = (dist[dst], node, paths[dst])

            _, _, path = best
            add_path(tree, tree_nodes, path)
            remaining.discard(path[-1])
        return tree

    def build_closure_mst():
        terminals = [src] + list(dsts)
        closure = nx.Graph()
        for a in terminals:
            dist, paths = sp_from(a)
            for b in terminals:
